methodology.conditioning: Full-deck chance, no selected runouts; four compatible private pairs, 44 rivers each, 176 physical worlds.
methodology.design: One same-run CFR+ call per backend at T=1500, capturing D=1000 and T=1500; fixed D/T tail extraction.
methodology.limitation: Derived numeric replay is not an arbitrary-policy exact certificate. No equilibrium claim; generic exact audit remains at its existing rejected work limit.
methodology.resources: The original complete 1500-sweep request retains the unchanged production 30,000,000 work admission; forecasts do not authorize admission.
methodology.threshold: NashConv <= 0.001 chips is report-only; every miss is retained.
methodology.timing: One complete solve plus callback observation; conversion and independent saved-profile replay timed separately. Uncontrolled wall-time only.
